data.text: For the choir director. A Psalm of David. How long, O Yahweh? Will You forget me forever? How long will You hide Your face from me?
How long shall I take counsel in my soul, Having sorrow in my heart all the day? How long will my enemy be exalted over me?
Look and answer me, O Yahweh my God; Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death,
Lest my enemy says, “I have overcome him,” And my adversaries rejoice that I am shaken.
But I have trusted in Your lovingkindness; My heart shall rejoice in Your salvation.
I will sing to Yahweh, Because He has dealt bountifully with me.
